answers.question: What is the exact PreToolUse rewrite rule set for 'flood-prone commands', beyond curl/wget examples?
answers.answer: ADR-0008 gives a closed list, stated as 'no new deny categories are added': (1) WebFetch -> deny, alt ctx_fetch_and_index + ctx_search; (2) curl/wget and inline HTTP (fetch(, requests.get( ...) -> deny only when the body reaches tool stdout, decided per pipeline by a hand-written lexer + recursive-descent parser (no regex) reading argv0 and parsed flags; allow when the body is written to a file (-o/-O/>) or the pipeline ends in a bounded sink (head -c N, wc, grep -c, jq with a scalar); (3) build tools (gradle, mvn, sbt) -> deny, alt is ctx_execute with intent, no tail; (4) Read of a file > 50 KB -> hint, not deny; (5) Grep and other Bash -> hint, once per session; (6) user permissions.deny -> deny. Parser constructs it cannot handle ([[, ((, case, functions, process substitution) -> allow and journal a ParseError code (GP3 lists every code). This is the full set; it is not open-ended.
answers.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0008-enforcement-rewrite-and-cap.md ("Same scope as v1" table, "What changes" table rows 1-3, "Parse errors" section, Golden cases GP3)
answers.archaeology: ADR-0008 already did the MUST-5 archaeology: source is v1 hooks/core/routing.mjs @ 5869f4fa (lines 670-900) plus tickets/data/isall.json issue titles. INTRODUCED_BY: v1 regex router over a quote-stripped string. ORIGINAL_INTENT (quoted from ADR-0008): stop raw HTTP bodies and build-tool floods from reaching the model. REGRESSION_RISK: the v1 regex matched inside quotes/heredocs/grep patterns, causing #1221 and #1106 (false denies); v2's own parser fixes this but any v2 regex shortcut would reintroduce the same bug class. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: decision must stay argv0+parsed-flag based, no regex, no truncation of the alternative text (owner rule).

answers.question: When PostToolUse caps oversized output, what is the exact byte cap number, and is it per tool or global?
answers.answer: No literal byte number for this cap exists in the docs. ADR-0016 and ADR-0008 both say the mechanism (whole-chunk BM25 selection under 'the budget', 'the same selection as ADR-0009') but never give the byte value, and never state per-tool vs global. The only concrete byte ceiling in the docs is the unrelated ctx_resume cap (2 KB, ADR-0009/TECH-SPEC GP6) and the doctor report cap (4,096 B, ADR-0014). Do not reuse either of those for the output-budget cap without an owner decision.
answers.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0016-subagent-context-protection.md line 30 ("under a byte budget"); docs/v2/adr/0008-enforcement-rewrite-and-cap.md line 28 ("the same output budget"); no numeric value in either file or in TECH-SPEC §6.7

docGapFinding.section: Rule / Three cases, one path each

answers.recommendation: Pick one literal number and state per-tool vs global explicitly in ADR-0016 before M0 codes the wrapper; recommend per-tool-call (not global per session), since GP6/GP10 already measure 'saved = sandbox bytes - returned bytes' per call id.

answers.question: What counts as a 'v1 leftover' for ctx_doctor to detect, as a literal list of paths and config keys?
answers.answer: ADR-0011's v1 cleanup table is the literal list, per agent: Claude Code - settings.json .hooks.* inner hooks whose command contains 'context-mode' AND a v1 script name or 'context-mode hook'; hooks/context-mode-cache-heal.{mjs,sh} + its SessionStart entry; ~/.claude.json .mcpServers["context-mode"]; data <configDir>/context-mode/. Codex - hooks.json entries (context-mode hook codex, hooks/codex/*.mjs); config.toml [mcp_servers.context-mode*]; data <codexHome>/context-mode/ (keep [features] hooks). Gemini - ~/.gemini/settings.json .hooks.* with context-mode; data ~/.gemini/context-mode/ (delete data only after a prompt). Qwen - ~/.qwen/settings.json .hooks.*; data ~/.qwen/context-mode/. Copilot CLI - whole file ~/.copilot/hooks/context-mode.json; data ~/.copilot/context-mode/. VS Code - whole file <project>/.github/hooks/context-mode.json. Kiro - ~/.kiro/agents/default.json .hooks.* flat entries; data ~/.kiro/context-mode/. Pi - packages[] "npm:context-mode" in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json; data ~/.pi/context-mode/. OpenCode - "context-mode" in .plugin[]. All agents - ~/.context-mode/ and tmp files context-mode-*.
answers.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0011-release-and-v1-transition.md, "v1 cleanup (no data migration)" table and "Facts" note
answers.archaeology: Root cause chain is already documented in ADR-0010: v1 doctor compared path strings against guesses, giving false PASS/FAIL (#1152 Codex hooks on by default, #1014 PASS on empty index, #548 path with a space, #712 Gemini path). ORIGINAL_INTENT: detect leftover v1 state without string-guessing. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: detectV1(agent) must compare parsed config as data against adapters/table.ts output, never path strings; never auto-delete Gemini/Antigravity-shared data without a prompt.

answers.question: Is the hard-deny-with-v1-scope rule (ADR-0008 r3) a fixed deny list shipped in v2, or is it generated fresh from v1's issue history at build time?
answers.answer: Fixed, hand-written list shipped in v2. ADR-0008 r3 states explicitly: 'No new deny categories are added.' The v1 issue history (tickets/data/isall.json, tickets/round4-evidence.json) was the research input used once to write ADR-0008's tables; it is not re-read at build time to regenerate the list. M0 should hand-code the deny/allow table from ADR-0008's two tables, not build a generator script.
answers.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0008-enforcement-rewrite-and-cap.md, "Same scope as v1" intro line and the "Sources" line at the top of the ADR

answers.question: What exact debug fields must an AI agent include in a bug issue for it to be accepted, per the 'maximum debug data' rule?
answers.answer: Per ADR-0014's ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml spec: an instruction line telling the agent to run /ctx-doctor (or call the ctx_doctor tool); a dropdown 'did doctor run?' with fixed No reasons; a required report textarea (render: text) holding the full typed ctx_doctor report (ctx-report: 1 ... digest: <sha256>, <=4,096 B, redacted by the typed scanner, never truncated); a required node --version input; free-text fields for what happened, what was expected, and steps to reproduce, where steps must name the exact denied tool and the exact alternative ctx_doctor/the hook gave; and 2 required checkboxes. Label: bug. This template is AI-agent-facing only; config.yml disables blank issues and feature.yml states PRs are not accepted.
answers.evidence: docs/v2/adr/0014-issue-forms-and-debug-report.md, section "5. GitHub files", ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml row; section "2. The report" for the report's exact structure and 4,096 B limit
